page.content:
Human realm Raiden protects from Outworld conquest.

How Earthrealm connects

  • Character: Liu Kang — Liu Kang is Earthrealm's chosen Shaolin champion.
  • Character: Raiden — Raiden is the thunder god who protects Earthrealm.
  • Topic: Mortal Kombat — Earthrealm is the human world the tournament is meant to protect.
  • Character: Shao Kahn — Shao Kahn uses the tournament — and then invasion — to take Earthrealm.
  • Character: Kung Lao — Kung Lao fights for Earthrealm beside Liu Kang.
  • Location: Wu Shi Academy — The Wu Shi Academy stands in Earthrealm.
  • Character: Sonya Blade — Sonya Blade represents Earthrealm's Special Forces.
  • Character: Johnny Cage — Johnny Cage keeps returning as an Earthrealm fighter.
  • Faction: Lin Kuei — The Lin Kuei are an Earthrealm assassin clan.
  • Faction: Shirai Ryu — The Shirai Ryu were an Earthrealm ninja clan before the massacre.

What is Earthrealm?

Earthrealm is the human world of Mortal Kombat: Shaolin temples, Special Forces, and the defenders who must win the tournament or face invasion.

Key threads lead to Liu Kang, Raiden, Mortal Kombat, Shao Kahn, Kung Lao and Wu Shi Academy.
